correctness.rationale: Parsed exact frozen check_partitions.py, check_recolor.cpp and check_grundy.cpp. First checker exhausts the independent 13-vertex masks, canonical five-independent-block partitions (377) and 5! labels; every legal one-vertex recoloring is generated, yielding 45,240 states/98,280 edges, two components 22,620 each, degree4=37,440 and degree6=7,800. Independently wrote/compiled a separate C++ proper-coloring enumerator and union-find checker and reproduced both k=5 counts and full k=6 census: 4,502,160 states/27,626,040 edges/one component. Grundy checker fixes a color-7 vertex via translation, exhausts six permutations on its neighbors and remaining legal assignments and checks every Grundy witness: no seven-Grundy coloring. Published Bonamy–Bousquet theorem gives mixing for all k>=Grundy+1>=7. This establishes graph-state connectivity, not rapid Markov-chain mixing or an infinite Paley family.
